actions: Free 127.0.0.1:8787 for the Bridge: curator-serve.service (folder-curator `serve`, default --port 8787, pid 6375 today) holds it, so move folder-curator to another port and repoint the n8n-nodes-folder-curator node at it, or amend architecture.md's Bridge port instead

With 8787 free, run `node packages/bridge/dist/bridge.mjs & sleep 1; curl -s -D- http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health; ss -ltnp | grep 8787; kill %1` on big-chungus and confirm HTTP/1.1 200 OK, X-Sidepiece-Contract: 1, and exactly one listener on 127.0.0.1:8787
